evals.prompt: My vault is the provided folder mini-vault. I just had my weekly ops meeting — the dictated transcript is in meeting-transcript.txt. Capture it in my vault.
evals.expected_output: A meeting note in Work/Meetings/ plus one task note per action item in Tasks/, all correctly linked, with dictated names resolved to existing people notes.
expectations: A meeting note is created in Work/Meetings/ with type: meeting, domain, created, and people frontmatter
Exactly 3 task notes are created in Tasks/, one per action point in the transcript
Each task note has type: task, status: not-started, and source linking the meeting note
The task about the proposal carries a due date — the Monday following the meeting (per 'by monday' in the transcript)
Dictated names are resolved to the existing notes Sarah Chen and Omar Haddad (no new duplicate person notes like 'Sara Chen' or 'Omar Hadad')
The meeting note's Action items section lists wikilinks to the task notes and contains no unchecked '- [ ]' checkboxes

evals.prompt: My vault is the provided folder mini-vault. Money update for our org 'Bright Futures' (I'm holding their donation money): 10 donations came in totalling 10,000 USD — 3 of them (1,000 each from Sarah Chen, Omar Haddad, and Lina Farouk) are for the Q3 Launch initiative; 5 (800 each, from Dana Kim, Tariq Aziz, Noor Salem, Ravi Menon, and one anonymous donor) are for the Winter Relief project; 2 (1,500 each from Omar Haddad and Sarah Chen) are general purpose. Then: I spent 3,000 from the Q3 Launch money... actually make that from the general fund on Q3 Launch costs. And I sent 5,000 to William Carter — he'll use it and return it. Set all of this up and tell me exactly where the money stands.
evals.expected_output: A fund owned by Bright Futures, 10 donation transactions with correct earmarks (one anonymous), an expense, an outstanding transfer, and a correct restated position: 2,000 cash, 5,000 receivable owed by William to Bright Futures.
expectations: A fund note (type: fund) is created with owner linking a Bright Futures org note (created as type: business), and the user as custodian
Exactly 10 transaction notes with direction in / status settled / txn donation; 3 earmarked to Q3 Launch, 5 to a Winter Relief initiative, 2 general — amounts matching (3x1000, 5x800, 2x1500)
The anonymous donation has no counterparty property and notes the anonymity in the body; named donors are linked (existing people resolved, new ones created once each)
The 3,000 expense is one transaction (out/settled/expense) earmarked per the user's correction (general fund, spent on Q3 Launch costs)
The William Carter transfer is out/outstanding/transfer — and the reply states William owes Bright Futures (the fund's owner), not the user personally
The final stated position is computed, correct, and explicit: 2,000 cash, 5,000 receivables, 0 pledges (10,000 in − 3,000 expense − 5,000 transfer)
No balances are silently invented; the math is shown or clearly derivable from the created notes

evals.prompt: My vault is the provided folder money-vault. Two money updates for the Relief Pot: William Carter repaid 3,000 of the 5,000 he owes; and Dana Kim's 1,000 pledge isn't happening — write it off. Where does the Relief Pot stand now?
evals.expected_output: Partial repayment handled by the split rule; pledge written off as cancelled; correct restated position: 8,000 cash, 2,000 receivable, 0 pledges.
expectations: A repayment transaction is created: in / settled / 3,000 / txn repayment, related-linked to the William transfer, inheriting fund and currency

The original transfer is SPLIT per money.md: an out+settled portion of 3,000 exists and the outstanding remainder is exactly 2,000 — total recorded outflow to William remains 5,000 (history not shrunk)
Dana Kim's pledge is set to status cancelled with a dated note — not deleted, and not counted in any balance
The restated position is computed and correct: 8,000 cash, 2,000 receivables (William owes Bright Futures), 0 pledges
Summing the transaction notes' signed amounts (excluding cancelled) reproduces the stated cash figure — no silent discrepancy
